segments.name: Solo digital marketing freelancers
segments.buyer: Solo digital marketing freelancer managing multiple small clients
segments.problem: Spending too much time manually collecting and formatting client testimonials
segments.access: Accessible via freelance platforms and LinkedIn groups
segments.tradeoff: Lower budget but high urgency for efficiency tools

segments.name: Small ecommerce store owners
segments.buyer: Owner of a small ecommerce store on Shopify or WooCommerce
segments.market: Small online retailers with direct customer feedback
segments.problem: Difficulty leveraging customer reviews effectively on their websites
segments.access: Accessible via ecommerce forums and Facebook business groups

segments.name: Startup marketing managers
segments.buyer: Marketing manager at an early-stage startup looking to boost conversions
segments.problem: Lack of consolidated, easy testimonial collection slowing marketing efforts
segments.access: Accessible via startup communities and LinkedIn
segments.tradeoff: Higher budget but longer sales cycle

firstBuyerWhy: The solo digital marketing freelancer is best due to urgent workflow need to save time, direct buying authority, ease of access, and willingness to adopt free-to-paid tools quickly; startup managers take longer to decide
paymentPath: Start free trial, then convert to monthly paid plan after seeing improved testimonial collection and display

firstExperiment.problem: Freelancers manually collecting testimonials takes too long
firstExperiment.identifyProspects: Search LinkedIn freelance marketing groups and Upwork profiles with testimonial-related keywords
firstExperiment.channelRationale: Direct access to target buyers actively seeking marketing tools, low cost, fast feedback
firstExperiment.firstAction: Join targeted LinkedIn groups and post an invitation to try Senja for free

resources.assumptions: Freelancers respond to relevant solutions posted in their groups

firstExperiment.commercialLearning: Learn urgency of testimonial collection pain, typical workarounds like manual approaches, decision authority, and initial willingness to pay for convenience
firstExperiment.continueWhen: Multiple freelancers express needs matching assumptions and use free tier
firstExperiment.adjustWhen: Low interest or no uptake after repeated outreach
firstExperiment.stopWhen: No meaningful engagement or interest after two weeks

alternatives.comparison: More targeted but higher effort and slower feedback than LinkedIn groups
alternatives.preferWhen: More precise buyer profiles needed or LinkedIn group access fails
alternatives.firstAction: Send personalized messages to freelancers on Upwork requesting product trial

alternatives.comparison: Broader reach but lower engagement and more noise than LinkedIn
alternatives.preferWhen: Poor LinkedIn response or to expand reach beyond LinkedIn
alternatives.firstAction: Post and engage in relevant Facebook groups with testimonial pain points content

messages.subject: Boost your clients' trust with easier testimonials
messages.body: Hi [Name], noticed you manage multiple clients—Senja helps you collect and share testimonials effortlessly. Interested in trying it free for your projects?

messages.subject: Following up on simplifying your testimonial collection
messages.body: Hi [Name], just checking if you had a chance to explore Senja? Happy to answer questions or help you get started for free.

positioning: Senja is a simple self-serve tool enabling solo marketers to quickly collect and organize testimonials, saving time and boosting client trust without complex setup.
unknowns: Actual willingness to pay after free use
